newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL Energy says wells encouraging.
newsitem.headline: FCL Energy says wells encouraging.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Energy on Thursday reported encouraging progress at its Mangahewa-2 and Kaimiro-13 wells.

Fletcher Energy said Mangahewa-2, onshore Northern Taranaki in New Zealand's North Island, had reached its target depth of 4,376 metres. The well was currently being completed and tests to establish unstimulated gas flows would start next week. If these flow results were satisfactory, fracture stimulation and long-term testing would start in May.
"The well has confirmed our estimate of net gas bearing sand thickness of approximately 550 metres," said Geoff Logan, General Manager Exploration and Production.
"In addition, down-hole measurement and core data shows that porosity, gas saturations and in situ permeability are within expected ranges."
